title: Pentagon Wars - Bradley Fighting Vehicle Evolution
summary: A roughly ten-minute scene from the movie The Pentagon Wars showing how the Bradley Fighting Vehicle's requirements ballooned through committee demands into a compromised design. It is a satirical dramatization of military procurement.
why: Linked in nearly every F-35 or procurement thread as the classic illustration of feature creep and design by stakeholder committee, including in software.

quote.text: It's a great example of how trying to design a product that works well for every stakeholder in every scenario leads to a Frankenstein of a product
